payload.claim: No test asserts that a per-step assistant event omits `output_tokens`. The source comment (lines 24-27) and the spec's Out-of-scope section both say output_tokens must not be carried per step because the SDK's own docs call it inaccurate there, but every test exercising this path (`test_the_counts_for_one_message_id_reach_the_log_once`) uses a `usage` dict that has no `output_tokens` key at all and only asserts the three step keys' *values*, never that `output_tokens` is absent from the event. Swapping `_STEP_USAGE_KEYS` for `_RESULT_USAGE_KEYS` on this line would make every assistant-step event leak an `output_tokens` field (a real, inaccurate number in production, since real usage mappings do carry that key) while the full test suite stays green.
